headline: Colorado says an unauthorized user accessed myColorado app data; the app is still offline and 50,000 to 150,000 people may be affected.
summary: New incident page. Read the state's myColorado.gov page (Nov 24 update and FAQ; Tier 1), The Record and KRDO. Main answer Confirmed on the state's own statement; answer_group hack-stated; incident_type breach. Service: down (c003). The state's 'no reason to believe it is part of a bigger attack' is its word alone, Reported. Data accessed, attacker and method: Not established. OIT's press release page refused automated access (403), not read. Privacy check done: no names, handles, emails or phone numbers.
